purpose: Test whether a privileged packet-level repair action can beat STR MLO without using more measured target-sender airtime before training another predictor.

selection_scope.selection_rationale: Use nontrivial cases that separate mechanism behavior: clear legacy, compound, and radio failures plus the sign-changing OBSS-intensity p17 and p19 pair.

common_contract.stream_and_environment: Use the exact frozen scenario configuration without favorable environment changes.
common_contract.fec_abstraction: Ideal systematic MDS-style erasure repair over equal-size padded source symbols; this is an optimistic action-space bound, not a claim about a concrete codec implementation.
common_contract.fec_payload_accounting: Each repair symbol has the full configured application payload size; padding and all wire/MAC overhead consume measured airtime.
common_contract.copy_or_repair_launch_order: ascending source or repair symbol index unless the oracle plan explicitly records another deterministic order

arms.description: Primary-only 5 GHz reference and source of exact no-repair packet outcomes.
Unconditional complete secondary copy at frame generation.
Unconditional complete secondary copy 2000 us after generation.

At T2, transmit only source packet indexes that the paired single-link run shows would still be absent at the inclusive deadline. This privileged hindsight replay is a mechanism ceiling and is not implementable.
arms.required_validity_check: The oracle run's primary-link packet outcomes must exactly match its paired no-repair source; otherwise the replay pair is invalid and must not support the decisive claim.

arms.description: At T2, unconditionally send ceil(k/8) ideal innovative repair symbols.

primary.name: all_generated_deadline_miss_rate
primary.denominator: every generated frame, including incomplete and collapse outcomes

secondary: all-generated deadline-censored latency distribution min(completion_latency, deadline)
mean, p95, and maximum consecutive deadline-miss burst length
primary and secondary MAC queue packets and service bytes at T2
primary ACK deficit count and exact packet indexes at T2
secondary action packet or repair-symbol count
secondary copy or repair completion latency from action time
target-sender PHY TX airtime per physical link and total
background throughput as a non-inferiority diagnostic

completed_frame_p99.reason: It is survivor-conditioned and is unassessable in collapse runs.

decisive_test.question: Can the privileged packet-level T2 repair arm lower all-generated deadline misses relative to STR MLO while consuming no more measured total target-sender PHY TX airtime?
decisive_test.airtime_definition: Sum of measured target-station PHY TX time over all physical links in the frozen measurement interval.
decisive_test.success: Oracle has fewer all-generated deadline misses and equal-or-lower measured total target-sender airtime than paired STR. Report paired point estimates and uncertainty; do not convert an underpowered interval into proof of equivalence.
decisive_test.failure: If a valid privileged oracle replay cannot form a point below and left of STR, stop predictor scaling and reconsider the multipath action architecture.
decisive_test.conditional_next_step: If the oracle succeeds, redesign the action around partial or coded repair, then train a causal model to choose that action.
decisive_test.prohibited_substitution: A post-hoc interpolation, static knapsack, or completed-frame-only latency result cannot by itself answer the decisive question.
